ruleset: Hardcore Worlds use the Hardcore Group Ironman death ruleset.

entries.name: Barbarian Assault
entries.rule: Dying here counts as your one Hardcore death.

entries.name: Camelot training room
entries.rule: Dying here counts as your one Hardcore death.

entries.name: Chambers of Xeric
entries.rule: Dying here counts as your one Hardcore death.

entries.name: Dream World (Lunar Diplomacy)
entries.rule: Dying in the Dream World during Lunar Diplomacy counts as your one Hardcore death.

entries.name: Fishing Trawler
entries.rule: Dying here counts as your one Hardcore death.

entries.name: Inferno
entries.rule: Dying here counts as your one Hardcore death.

entries.name: Magic Training Arena
entries.rule: Dying here counts as your one Hardcore death.

entries.name: Nightmare Zone
entries.rule: Dying here counts as your one Hardcore death.

entries.name: Pest Control
entries.rule: Dying here counts as your one Hardcore death.

entries.name: Player-owned house
entries.rule: Dying inside a player-owned house counts as your one Hardcore death.

entries.name: PvM Arena
entries.rule: Dying here counts as your one Hardcore death.

entries.name: TzHaar Fight Cave
entries.rule: Dying here counts as your one Hardcore death. See the Karamja Elite diary entry for the one exception.

entries.name: Random events
entries.rule: Dying during a random event counts as your one Hardcore death.

entries.name: Rogues' Den maze
entries.rule: Dying in the maze counts as your one Hardcore death.

entries.name: Castle Wars
entries.rule: A death here is safe and does not end your Hardcore run.

entries.name: Clan Wars
entries.rule: A death here is safe and does not end your Hardcore run.

entries.name: Soul Wars
entries.rule: A death here is safe and does not end your Hardcore run.

entries.name: TzHaar Fight Pit
entries.rule: A death here is safe. Not the same place as the TzHaar Fight Cave, which is unsafe.

entries.name: The Fremennik Trials (Koschei)
entries.rule: Only a death in Koschei's 4th phase is safe.

entries.name: Karamja Elite diary: Fight Cave resurrection
entries.rule: Being resurrected in the Fight Cave by the Karamja Elite diary reward is safe. Otherwise a Fight Cave death is unsafe.

entries.name: Western Provinces Elite diary: Zulrah resurrection
entries.rule: Being resurrected at Zulrah by the Western Provinces Elite diary reward is safe.

entries.name: Galvek and Glough replays
entries.rule: Replays of these boss fights are safe.

entries.name: Last Man Standing
entries.rule: Disabled on Hardcore Worlds at launch.

entries.name: Bounty Hunter
entries.rule: Disabled on Hardcore Worlds at launch.
